entries.description: Defined the fixed characterization record schema (docs/research/gallery-survey/schema.md): identity/citation, staff (orientation, pitch-axis, interval structure, lines/octave, semitonePattern equivalent, line variations, compactness), ledgers, noteheads (shape/fill/color/glyph schemes), auxiliary devices (clef, key signature, octave markers, accidentals), duration representation; every attribute has a closed value set plus unknown.

Harvested the musicnotation.org gallery (54 systems in 10 categories, verified against raw HTML detail links) into docs/research/gallery-survey/index.md, and characterized every indexed system from its detail page text + gallery image(s) into catalog.md — 54 schema-conformant records plus the supplementary out-of-gallery Dodeka record (S1). All 55 records machine-validated against the schema field list and closed enums; unknown recorded wherever sources did not support a confident value (most commonly duration.representation and noteheads.fill-scheme).

Defined tiers 1-4 against the three confirmed platform invariants (I1 horizontal orientation, I2 one pitch per vertical position, I3 duration-as-notehead-style); classified all 55 catalog records (22 Tier 1 [9 firm/13 provisional], 12 Tier 2 [8/4], 2 Tier 3 [both provisional], 19 Tier 4); wrote feed-forward lists for set 011 sessions 1 and 2; machine-validated catalog-matrix-requirements consistency (validate-s2.mjs, all checks passed).

Wrote enhancement-requirements catalog: E1 custom clefs/register devices (10 drivers, scope authority for set 009), E2 custom key signatures (4 drivers, set 010), E3 custom stem/duration marks (4 drivers, recommended as future set), E4 custom accidental marks (3 drivers, recommended to ride with 010); binding default rule stated per entry.

Supersedes step 1 counts after the human UAT round: operator reviewed all 14 sampled systems and re-tiered record 14 (Note for Note) from Tier 1 to Tier 3 (bounded staff extent gap). Final classification of 55 records: 21 Tier 1 (8 firm / 13 provisional), 12 Tier 2 (8/4), 3 Tier 3 (1/2), 19 Tier 4. Feed-forward: 8 firm Tier-1 targets for set-011 session 1; 8 firm Tier-2 + 3 documented Tier-3 partials for session 2. Consistency validator re-run after corrections: all checks passed. UAT sample, verbatim operator responses, corrections, and remark dispositions recorded in s2-uat.md.
